Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded
                sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners at the same address with the same last
                name who were created with 'sharesHousehold' true. Absent for owners not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year, assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email
                is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
